<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<Policy xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:core:schema:wd-17" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" PolicyId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:2.0:conformance-test:IIC002:policy" RuleCombiningAlgId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:rule-combining-algorithm:deny-overrides" Version="1.0" >
    <Description>
        Policy for Conformance Test IIC002.
    </Description>
    <Target/>
    <Rule Effect="Permit" RuleId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:2.0:conformance-test:IIC002:rule">
        <Description>
            A subject who is at least 5 years older than Bart
            Simpson may read Bart Simpson's medical record.
        </Description>
        <Condition>
<Apply FunctionId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:integer-greater-than-or-equal">
            <Apply FunctionId="urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:1.0:function:integer-subtract">
                <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer">10</AttributeValue>
                <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer">3</AttributeValue>
            </Apply>
            <AttributeValue DataType="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer">5</AttributeValue>
        
</Apply>
        </Condition>
    </Rule>
</Policy>
